description:
Impact Games India (IGI) is a district-level Rotary initiative led by Rotary Club of Mumbai SOBO and Rotary Club of Mumbai Airport, with support from other Rotary clubs. The initiative brought together Rotary members, their families and friends through 15 sporting categories, encouraging participation, fitness, sportsmanship and fellowship.

The games were inaugurated on 2 October 2026 at Wellington Club, followed by sporting matches across various categories throughout October. The initiative concluded with a felicitation and awards ceremony on 1 November 2026 at NSCI, Worli. I attended both the inauguration and the concluding award ceremony, representing Rotary Club of Deonar.
